name: Lost in Battle

angles.text: Mankrik's desperate plea showcases the perils facing Horde settlers and patrols traveling through the contested Barrens against Bristleback quilboar.
Mankrik fought fiercely in traditional orcish battle-rage to defend his mate, only to be overwhelmed by the quilboar swarm.
The ambush took place at a small tauren camp, and it was a wandering tauren druid who tended Mankrik's wounds along the Gold Road and saved his life.
A tauren druid passing along the Gold Road came across Mankrik just as he collapsed, tending his severe wounds and keeping him alive.

faq.answer: Mankrik is an orc warrior currently recovering at the Crossroads in the Barrens. After suffering a brutal attack by quilboar that separated him from his wife, he relies on travelers to search the scrublands for any sign of her.

While Mankrik and his wife were fighting together at a small tauren camp, they were ambushed by Bristleback quilboar. His wife held off three attackers single-handedly before fresh reinforcements overwhelmed her, and Mankrik was separated from her in the chaos.
faq.q: What happened to Mankrik's wife during the battle?

faq.answer: After Mankrik was overwhelmed and collapsed in battle, a wandering tauren druid discovered him on the Gold Road and tended his life-threatening wounds before he could succumb to them.
faq.q: How did Mankrik survive the quilboar ambush?

faq.answer: The attackers were Bristleback quilboar who swarmed a small tauren settlement. Their sheer numbers overpowered both Mankrik and his wife despite their fierce resistance.
faq.q: Who attacked Mankrik and his wife?

aliases: where do i look for her
where to search for mankriks wife
faq.answer: Mankrik was found along the Gold Road after falling near a small tauren camp overrun by Bristlebacks. Travelers searching for her begin by scouting the quilboar-infested areas across the Barrens.
faq.q: Where should travelers look for Mankrik's wife?

faq.answer: Mankrik is currently resting at the Crossroads, the central Horde outpost in the Barrens, waiting anxiously for any news or sign of his missing wife.
faq.q: Where can Mankrik be found now?

sections.body: The quest begins with Mankrik, an orc warrior stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. While fighting alongside his wife at a small tauren camp, the pair were suddenly ambushed and overwhelmed by a swarm of Bristleback quilboar. During the desperate skirmish, his wife held off three Bristlebacks on her own before being cut off by fresh enemy reinforcements, separating the two in the heat of combat.
sections.title: Ambush at the Camp

sections.body: In a blind rage, Mankrik turned to confront the advancing quilboar, but their sheer numbers brought him down easily. Near death, he was discovered on the Gold Road by a passing tauren druid who tended his wounds and saved his life. Unable to search for her himself due to his injuries, Mankrik begs travelers passing through the Crossroads to search the Barrens and bring back any sign of his beloved wife.
sections.title: A Desperate Search

summary: "Lost in Battle" is a poignant quest offered by the wounded orc Mankrik at the Crossroads in the Barrens. After a devastating Bristleback quilboar ambush separates him from his wife at a nearby tauren camp, Mankrik asks passing adventurers to search the dangerous scrublands for any sign of her fate.
attribution: In-game quest text: Lost in Battle
